text: 四十不考虑四十倒是无所谓，但你不能让四十岁男来骚扰我们二十岁女的，他不要脸我们女生还要脸呢。
en: It's one thing for a forty-year-old not to consider a forty-year-old, but you can't let a forty-year-old man come and harass us twenty-year-old women; he may be shameless, but we girls still care about our dignity.

text: 你看，人家没有陪你长大，你为什么要陪人一起变老？
en: Look, they didn't grow up with you, so why should you grow old together with them?

text: 40岁的女人生育很艰难了，就算怀上唐氏儿或其他基因问题的孩子概率变很大。
en: A forty-year-old woman already has great difficulty bearing children, and even if she conceives, the probability of having a child with Down's syndrome or other genetic problems becomes much greater.

text: 哦，或者不打算生育，那还考虑什么，对方是富婆？
en: Oh, or if she has no plans to bear children, then what is there to consider — is the other party a wealthy woman?

text: 富婆才看不上同年龄的老腊肉呢。
en: Wealthy women wouldn't fancy men their own age anyway.

text: 除非是这种四十岁的女人…
en: Unless it's this kind of forty-year-old woman…

text: 那不是40岁男人了，18到80的都感兴趣。
en: Then it's not only forty-year-old men — those from eighteen to eighty are all interested.

text: 题主说，自己是做婚姻中介的，他想知道，为什么40岁的男性不考虑40岁的女性？
en: The original poster said that he runs a marriage agency and wants to know why forty-year-old men don't consider forty-year-old women?

text: 20岁左右的男性
en: Men around twenty

text: 一般会考虑和自己年纪接近的女人
en: generally consider women close to their own age

text: 30岁左右的男性
en: Men around thirty

text: 一般考虑比自己小五岁左右的女人
en: generally consider women about five years younger than themselves

text: 40岁左右的男性
en: Men around forty

text: 一般考虑比自己小8到10岁的女人
en: generally consider women 8 to 10 years younger than themselves

text: 也就是说，你的这些40岁左右的男性客户
en: In other words, these forty-something male clients of yours

text: 他们的目标人选，可能是30到32岁的女性
en: their target candidates may be women aged thirty to thirty-two

text: 50岁左右的男性
en: Men around fifty

text: 一般会考虑比自己小10到15岁的女性
en: generally consider women 10 to 15 years younger than themselves

text: 所以考虑40岁女性的男性客户，可能是50岁到55岁的男性。
en: So the male clients who consider forty-year-old women may be men aged fifty to fifty-five.

text: 换句话说男性的年龄越大，他们理想中的异性，与自己的年龄差就会越大。
en: In other words, the older the man, the greater the age gap between him and his ideal partner.

text: 这指的还是实力较为普通的男性择偶心态
en: And this still refers to the mate-selection mindset of relatively ordinary men.

text: 如果是个人实力很强的中年男性
en: If it is a middle-aged man of considerable personal stature,

text: 可能会考虑比自己小20岁到30岁的女性
en: he may consider women 20 to 30 years younger than himself

text: 比如张艺谋比妻子大31岁。
en: For example, Zhang Yimou is 31 years older than his wife.

text: 张艺谋和妻子刚认识的时候，妻子才18岁，而张艺谋已经将近50了。
en: When Zhang Yimou and his wife first met, his wife was only 18, while Zhang Yimou was already nearly 50.

text: 张艺谋当时已经50了，但是人家就能找一个18岁的少女。
en: Zhang Yimou was already 50 by then, yet he could still find an 18-year-old girl.

text: 这就是人家作为一个成功男士的个人魅力。
en: That is the personal charm of a successful man.

text: 50岁还能赢得一个18岁少女的芳心。
en: At 50 he could still win the heart of an 18-year-old girl.

text: 李敖有两任夫人，第一任是风华绝代的女明星胡因梦，比李敖小18岁，他俩结婚时李敖45岁，胡因梦27岁
en: Li Ao had two wives; his first was the stunningly beautiful actress Hu Yinmeng, 18 years his junior. When they married, Li Ao was 45 and Hu Yinmeng was 27.

text: 李敖第二任夫人比李敖小32岁，李敖初次遇到第二任夫人时，李敖51岁，他夫人19岁。
en: Li Ao's second wife was 32 years younger than him; when Li Ao first met his second wife, Li Ao was 51 and his wife was 19.

text: 再比如张纪中和王石，也是找了一个比自己小30多岁的妻子。
en: Another example: Zhang Jizhong and Wang Shi also married wives over 30 years younger than themselves.

text: 郭富城找的妻子，比自己小20岁左右。
en: Aaron Kwok's wife is about 20 years younger than him.

text: 这些成功男性对于另一半的年龄标准，可能会要求对方更年轻
en: These successful men's age criteria for a partner may require the other party to be younger.

text: 可能会找比自己小20岁甚至到30岁以上的女性。
en: They may seek women 20 years, or even over 30 years, younger than themselves.

text: 这是人类的共性，无论是美国的马斯克，还是咱们国内的成功男人，在他们成功之后，他们会去找和自己同龄的女人吗？
en: This is a common human trait — whether it is America's Musk or our own successful men at home, after they succeed, would they go looking for women their own age?

text: 尤其是那些已经五六十岁的成功男士，他们就一定会找一个五六十岁的女人吗？
en: Especially those successful men already in their fifties or sixties — would they necessarily find a woman in her fifties or sixties?

text: 大概率不会。
en: Most likely not.

text: 马斯克上一个女友才20来岁，在他年纪大之后，他找的女性伴侣都比他小很多。
en: Musk's last girlfriend was only in her twenties; after he grew older, the female partners he sought were all much younger than him.

text: 古今中外都是如此，这就是人类的普遍现象，你没有必要去扭转人类的普遍现象。
en: This has been true throughout history and across all cultures; it is a universal human phenomenon, and there is no need for you to try to reverse a universal human phenomenon.

text: 可能你内心中觉得这种现象不合理，但你是做中介的，你不要去管这种现象合理不合理，你不要去纠结这种现象是对是错。
en: You may inwardly feel that this phenomenon is unreasonable, but you are an agent — do not concern yourself with whether the phenomenon is reasonable, and do not agonise over whether it is right or wrong.

text: 你的目的是为了让你的婚姻中介所生存，你的目的是赚钱养家。
en: Your aim is to keep your marriage agency going; your aim is to earn money and support your family.

text: 有句话叫势比人强，一个个体是很难扭转整体趋势的。
en: There is a saying: circumstances outweigh the individual — a single person finds it very hard to reverse an overall trend.

text: 当年有一个关于齐白石的趣闻
en: There was once an anecdote about Qi Baishi.

text: 说的是齐白石先生已经90多岁了
en: It goes that Mr Qi Baishi was already over ninety.

text: 他的朋友就给他介绍了一个女人，这个女人40岁
en: His friend introduced him to a woman, who was 40.

text: 这已经比齐白石小50多岁了
en: This was already over 50 years younger than Qi Baishi.

text: 但齐白石当场就怒了，他说我只想找20出头的女人
en: But Qi Baishi flew into a rage on the spot; he said he only wanted to find a woman just over twenty.

text: 所以齐白石先生最后找的伴侣只有20出头。
en: So the partner Mr Qi Baishi ended up with was only just over twenty.

text: 这听起来虽然有些匪夷所思
en: Although this sounds somewhat unimaginable,

text: 但齐白石作为一个成功人士，他就有能力找到如此之年轻的伴侣。
en: as a successful person, Qi Baishi had the means to find such a young partner.

text: 你作为从事婚姻中介的人，你不要去试图改变这些男性用户的观念
en: As someone in the marriage-matching business, you should not try to change these male clients' attitudes.

text: 就像当年齐白石的朋友，如果劝他找一个40岁的，甚至和他同龄的九十岁女人
en: Just as with Qi Baishi's friend back then — if he had advised him to find a 40-year-old, or even a ninety-year-old woman the same age as himself,

text: 齐白石会听吗？
en: would Qi Baishi have listened?

text: 我们应该尊重个人选择。
en: We should respect personal choice.

text: 每个人都有选择自己理想配偶的权力。
en: Everyone has the right to choose their ideal spouse.

text: 无论人家想找的是什么样的人，那都是人家的自由。
en: Whatever sort of person they wish to find, that is their freedom.

text: 对方的观念是很难被改变的。
en: The other party's mindset is very difficult to change.

text: 既然你作为中介，你都知道你们中介所的那些40岁的男性客户都不愿意找同岁的女性，这就是现实，这就是普遍的现实
en: Since, as an agent, you already know that those forty-year-old male clients at your agency are unwilling to seek women their own age, this is reality — this is the prevalent reality.

text: 这是你作为一个业内人，接触了大量客户得出来的真实的结果。
en: This is the genuine result you arrived at as an industry insider who has dealt with a great many clients.

text: 那你就要去尊重现实。
en: Then you must respect reality.

text: 你如果想要赚到中介费，你应该做的就是尽量给你的客户找到他们喜欢的类型，而不是扭转他们的态度。
en: If you want to earn your commission, what you should do is try your best to find your clients the type they like, rather than reversing their attitudes.

text: 评论区有个朋友说：多新鲜啊，同样实力强的女人也不找比自己大的啊
en: A friend in the comments section said: How novel — successful women of equal stature also don't go for men older than themselves, do they?

text: 我这篇文章，分析的是男性择偶心态
en: My article analyses men's mate-selection mindset.

text: 题主是一个婚姻中介，他问我怎样改变男性客户的择偶观念？
en: The original poster is a marriage agent who asked me how to change male clients' mate-selection attitudes?

text: 我是回答题主的问题，所以我分析了一下男性的心态
en: I am answering the original poster's question, so I analysed men's mindset.

text: 实力强的女人会找什么，跟这个问题有什么关系？
en: What a strong woman would seek has what bearing on this question?

text: 跟题主又有什么关系？
en: And what bearing does it have on the original poster?

text: 而且实力强的女性都一定找比自己小的吗？
en: Moreover, do all strong women necessarily seek those younger than themselves?

text: 巩俐够成功吧？
en: Gong Li is successful enough, isn't she?

text: 她的实力已经很强了吧？
en: Her stature is already very considerable, isn't it?

text: 然而巩俐的历任老公和男朋友都比她大十岁以上。
en: Yet all of Gong Li's husbands and boyfriends have been over ten years older than her.

text: 章子怡够成功吧？
en: Zhang Ziyi is successful enough, isn't she?

text: 她前夫汪峰比她大八岁。
en: Her ex-husband Wang Feng is eight years older than her.

text: 这些成功女性怎么没找比她们年轻的呢？
en: Why didn't these successful women find someone younger than themselves?

text: 是她们找不到吗？
en: Is it that they couldn't find one?

text: 其实分析一下现实情况，实力强的成功女性，哪怕在她们成功之后，也有很多会找比自己年长的丈夫。
en: In fact, if we analyse the real situation, many successful women of great stature, even after their success, marry husbands older than themselves.

text: 但男性成功之后，就很少会娶比自己年长的妻子。
en: But after men succeed, they rarely marry wives older than themselves.

text: 女性的心态和男性是不一样的。
en: Women's mindset is not the same as men's.

text: 所以不能一概而论。
en: So one cannot generalise.

text: 张东健老婆跟他同龄，1972年的，玄彬老婆跟他同龄1982年的，结婚时候女方都超过了40岁。
en: Jang Dong-gun's wife is the same age as him, born in 1972; Hyun Bin's wife is the same age as him, born in 1982 — and both women were over 40 when they married.

text: 你说这种一线大帅哥们有资本找个20多岁的不？
en: Tell me, with their status, don't these top-tier handsome actors have the means to find someone in their twenties?
